edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $425,000, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings. The Executive shall be eligible to receive an annual target bonus equal to 75% of annual base salary, subject to achievement of applicable Company and individual performance goals as established by the Board or its Compensation Committee and the terms of the Company’s applicable bonus plan. The Executive shall also be eligible to participate in employee benefit plans generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of those plans.
edits.name: Compensation

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. In the event the Executive’s employment is terminated by the Company without Cause, and subject to the Executive’s timely execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims in favor of the Company and its affiliates, the Executive shall receive severance equal to 18 months of the Executive’s then-current base salary plus 18 months of the Executive’s then-current target annual bonus, payable in a lump sum on the first regular payroll date following the effectiveness of the release. In addition, subject to the Executive’s timely election of continuation coverage under COBRA, the Company shall pay or reimburse the employer portion of the premiums for continued group health coverage for up to 18 months following termination, or until the Executive becomes eligible for comparable coverage from another employer, if earlier, subject in all cases to applicable law and the terms of the relevant plans.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. The Executive shall be subject to narrowly tailored confidentiality, non-solicitation and non-disparagement obligations compliant with applicable law. The Executive shall not use or disclose the Company’s confidential information except as required in the proper performance of the Executive’s duties or as otherwise permitted by law. During employment and for 12 months thereafter, the Executive shall not knowingly solicit for employment any employee of the Company with whom the Executive had material business contact during the 12 months preceding termination, provided that general solicitations not targeted at Company employees shall not violate this provision. The Executive and the Company shall not make knowingly false or materially disparaging statements about the other, subject to legally protected rights and truthful statements made in legal, regulatory or administrative proceedings. Nothing in this Agreement limits any rights the Executive may have under applicable law to communicate with governmental agencies, participate in investigations, report possible violations of law, or engage in protected activity.
edits.name: Restrictive Covenants
